title: Approved recovery objectives table
description: Versioned table of RPO and RTO per data class (C0 to C4 in RR-UNB-RES-003-r2) and per customer-facing capability, with fault assumptions, approver and the contract clause that references it.

title: Failover topology and fencing test results
description: Description of replica placement, quorum configuration and fencing mechanism, plus results of automated tests that a stale replica cannot authorize financial writes and that failover never produces two writers.

title: DR exercise report with measured recovery times
description: Dated report of each failover or restore exercise stating scenario, data class, start and end timestamps, achieved RTO and RPO versus objectives, data-integrity verification results and remediation items. Production and synthetic evidence are labeled distinctly.
notes: SOC2-031 requires production evidence to be kept distinct from test or synthetic evidence.

title: Recovery dependency map
description: Machine-readable graph of what each capability needs to recover (DNS, identity provider, key management, secrets, CI/CD, database, object storage, payment connectivity) with recovery order and the alternate for each.
format: JSON graph generated from infrastructure definitions

title: Environment rebuild-from-source test
description: Result of rebuilding a complete environment in a clean account from source, infrastructure definitions and Strata schema, then restoring data and passing integrity checks.

title: Tenant-selective restore test result
description: Evidence that one tenant's data was restored to a chosen point in time without altering other tenants, with negative isolation checks on the restored data.

title: Post-restore payment safety verification
description: Record that after a restore, payment release stayed blocked until C0 consistency checks and provider reconciliation passed, including the list of payments in Unknown status and how each was resolved.

title: Disaster declaration and customer notification log
description: Time-stamped log of disaster declaration, decision maker, customer notifications sent and acknowledgments, and the post-event report.
